steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Daily scorecard** in *CASE and conditional aggregation*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Daily scorecard cold
prompt: Build Teodor's daily scorecard. One row per **day** (first 10 characters of `started`), in date order, with:
- **pct_member**: percentage of rides by members, rounded to the nearest whole number (watch out for integer division)
Table: `rides(id, bike, rider_id, start_station, end_station, started, minutes, fare, plan, rating)`. `rating` (1 to 5) is NULL when the rider skipped the survey; `plan` is `'member'` or `'casual'`.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
